explanation: Decomposers are microorganisms (bacteria and fungi) that break down complex organic remains of dead plants and animals into simple inorganic nutrients. Role: 1. Clean environment by recycling nutrients back to soil. 2. Prevent natural waste accumulation.

question: Explain Biological Magnification with an example and explain why food chains generally have only 3 to 4 steps.
options: Biological Magnification: Non-biodegradable chemicals like DDT sprayed on crops enter food chain (Plankton -> Small Fish
explanation: Biological Magnification: Non-biodegradable chemicals like DDT sprayed on crops enter food chain (Plankton -> Small Fish -> Large Fish -> Birds/Humans). Since these chemicals cannot be metabolized or excreted, their concentration increases at each successive trophic level, reaching maximum in top carnivores. Food chain step limit: According to 10% energy law, only 10% energy is transferred to next level. After 3-4 steps, remaining energy is too miniscule to support higher trophic populations.
